design.arms: control = std, no choices, both sides. Each option twice: treatment on blue (red = control) and on red (blue = control); same seed = pair.
design.layout: objectiveLayoutForSeed(seed); the dragon pit is next to blue's duo lane in STANDARD (2026-09-30 audit) => STANDARD seeds = blue is the dragon side. Every comparison is also reported split by 'the treated side is the dragon side' (report only).

options.note: quick-mode strong side bottom (early + mid focusLane bot), the live v21 shortcut
the '~2x ganks' case (C6 chkComboEarly: early ganks x1.99 blue / x1.81 red; x1.006 of strong side alone => the doubling comes from the strong side itself)
no dragon and no economy component: baseline for a colour asymmetry that is not specific to an option

primary.metric: goldLeadAt.early (own team gold minus enemy team gold at the end of the early phase; null if the match ended in the phase)
primary.estimand: D = mean over seeds of (Delta_red - Delta_blue), Delta_side = treatment - control on the same seed and side (paired; both sides needed)
primary.test: TOST, two one-sided z tests at alpha 0.05 each = the 90% CI of D

verdict.PASS: the 90% CI of D lies inside (-150, +150)
verdict.STOP: the 90% CI of D lies entirely outside [-150, +150] (a side difference larger than the margin is demonstrated) => release blocker, Owner
verdict.INCONCLUSIVE: otherwise; not a pass, the Owner decides (release stays blocked on this item until then)

economicMeaning.goldSources: LogicEngine: kill 300 to the team (+150 assist share via items.earnKill), tower 250, dragon 200, baron 400, passive 14 per second per team
economicMeaning.scale: 150 gold = half a kill = 0.17 SD of the control's early gold lead (SD 886, C6 control n=400, |lead| median 550) = about half of the map's dragon-side early advantage (control: dragon-side team leads by +332 as blue / +227 as red at the end of the early phase)
economicMeaning.reading: a side difference within +/-150 is smaller than one assist share and well inside the existing layout effect; a difference above it would mean an option systematically pays one colour about half a kill more than the other

power.source: descriptive re-analysis of already observed data (C6 seeds 4201-4600; tools/analyze_side_asymmetry_3aB.mjs). Not evidence, only the variance.
power.tostPowerN400: power at a true D of 0 / 50 / 100: earlySnowball 0.13 / 0.11 / 0.06, chkFocusBotEarly 0.34 / 0.27 / 0.14, chkAggrEarly 0.42 / 0.33 / 0.16
power.requiredN: 80% power at a true D of 0 needs SE <= 150 / 2.926 = 51.3 => n >= (SD / 51.3)^2: about 790 (SD 1440) to 1050 (SD 1661). n=1200 gives SE 48 (SD 1661): power 0.86 at D=0, 0.66 at D=50
power.estimatorVariance: R - B (no control) has a similar SD (1537 for earlySnowball) because the treatment and control matches are correlated (r 0.4-0.6); the paired estimand is kept
power.priorSignal: C6 point estimates of D (already seen, not evidence): earlySnowball +185 (z 2.23), chkFocusBotEarly +51 (z 0.71). All six early-acting C6 arms share one control arm, so their common red>blue sign is not six independent observations.

guards.rule: per arm and side, same-seed pairs vs the control on the same side; n as registered for the arm

items.note: own bottom lane = adc + support; threshold proposed, Owner to confirm
safety band only (same line as G-A8); never a claim that a tactic is favourable (Owner)

items.rule: ratio = treatment mean / control mean, 95% CI from the paired difference
items.harmful: the lower 95% bound of the ratio > 2.0
items.inconclusive: point ratio > 2.0 but the CI includes 2.0
items.note: C6 point ratio 1.99 (blue) sits on the old 2.0 level check; a point-estimate rule would STOP about half of new samples by chance, so the CI rule is proposed; Owner to confirm

interactions.rule: report; flag if |z| >= 3 (combination differs from the sum of its parts)

overallVerdict: STOP if any primary comparison or guard says STOP; PASS only if every primary comparison is PASS and no guard is harmful or inconclusive; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE

notClaimed.outcome: no win-rate claim; win rate is a safety band and a report only
notClaimed.attribution: a STOP or INCONCLUSIVE is reported with the dragon-side split and the reference arm; no coefficient, engine or rule change is made in response without the Owner

cost.primaryN1200: control + 2 primary options x 2 sides at 1200 = 6,000; 3 safety/reference options x 2 sides at 400 = 2,400; total 8,400 matches ~ 3 h (3 workers, ~1.3 s/match)
